name: Isaiah Pressman
method: App built-in browser, 30 October 2026. Loaded the public Kaggle About page and Competitions page for pressman1 (one page at a time, six-second waits, no block or rate limit shown), read the page text and the page's element labels, and took screenshots of the profile header, the medal counters and the completed-competitions list. Medal colours were read from the gold and silver medal icons on each list row and match the page's own element labels. The own-profile avatar address was read from the profile header's background image. This file replaces an older draft that was written from Kaggle's data endpoints while the site was blocking the browser; no claim from that draft was carried over unless the live pages show it now.

facts.text: IsaiahP (pressman1) is a Kaggle Competitions Grandmaster with five gold and three silver competition medals, ranked 14th of 225,021 when checked and 8th at his best.
Kaggle lists his Orbit Wars result as 1st of 4,729 teams with a gold medal, on an entry that shows only his account.
Kaggle lists ARC Prize 2025 as 3rd of 1,455 teams with a gold medal, on an entry that shows five accounts: jcole75, driessmit1, pressman1, moeosman and michaelhodel. The medal belongs to that team.
His other team gold medals on Kaggle are Lux AI (1st of 1,178 teams), Hungry Geese (2nd of 879) and NeurIPS 2024 - Lux AI Season 3 (2nd of 701); he shares each entry with other accounts.
His Kaggle competitions tab also lists active entries in both ARC Prize 2026 competitions, ARC-AGI-3 and ARC-AGI-2, which still had days to go when checked, so neither has a final result.

teamNotes: Medals belong to teams, so none of the team results above is claimed as an individual honour. Kaggle's competition rows show the accounts on each entry but not the team name, so no team name is recorded here (teamName is null throughout); names in the older draft are not carried over. The profile's own activity box counts three solo competitions and eight in a team, and the three rows that show only pressman1 are Orbit Wars, Kaggriculture and AI Village Capture the Flag. The two active ARC Prize 2026 cards show the accounts listed under activeEntries; the repo already holds Tufa Labs team memberships for both from the public ARC rosters, and no standing is read from Kaggle here, so any leaderboard position seen elsewhere stays provisional.
